{{Quote|My name is Jek, thanks for the save.|Bannon introduces himself|<ref name="Suns of Fortune">{{FFG|story=Conical Six Summit|book=Suns of Fortune}}</ref>}}
'''Jek Bannon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Five Brothers Resort and Casino]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Centerpoint Station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Whilst working for the [[Casino/Legends|casino]], he was sent to take promotional pictures of the [[Conical Six]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] but passed out due to heat exhaustion during the climb. He was found and rescued by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] also hired to perform work for the casino on the mountain.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wizard, you guys really saved my neck. It started to get hot, I went to put on my rebreather and must of passed out before I got it.|Bannon explains what happened to his rescuers|<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] Jek Bannon worked for the [[Five Brothers Resort and Casino]], an establishment on the [[Centerpoint Station|Centerpoint]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. At the age of fifteen he worked under the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sura]] as part of the Five Brothers' operations on [[Conical Six]], one of the the space stations' [[Southern Conical Mountains]]. Shortly after Five Brothers' obtained the rights to exclusive use of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]], Sura sent Bannon up the mountain to capture a number of [[Hologram/Legends|holographic images]] for commercial use by the casino. The boy brought a bag of equipment with him, but after encountering the extreme heat generated by [[Glowpoint]], an artificial [[Star/Legends|sun]] near the mountain, he passed out in a cave while trying to put on a [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreather]].<ref name="SoF" />

{{RPG}}
A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] hired by the casino to clear out a [[Vynock/Legends|vynock]] infestation on the mountain later found Bannon, and after the group were attacked by several vynocks, he awoke and thanked them before contacting Sura to arrange pick up. The group, one of whom collected Bannon's bag, then brought the boy with them to the mountains summit where an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] collected them all. Thankful to see him safe Sura paid the spacers an extra 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his rescue and the return of the equipment.<ref name="SoF" />

==Personality and traits==
When found by spacers he was extremely thankful, as was Sura who had worried for the young boy when he didn't return.<ref name="SoF" />
{{Endgame}}
Bannon was a fair-skinned, [[Color/Legends|brown]] haired, Human male, who was confident enough to climb a mountain alone at the age of fifteen, although the task proved too much for him.<ref name="SoF" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|I'm going to comm Sura and get her to send the rescue flitter to meet us at the summit.|Bannon tells his saviors his plan|<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />}}
While climbing the mountain Bannon wore a brown [[Clothing/Legends|vest]] and pants. He also carried a bag of equipment, including a rebreather, large amounts of [[Rope/Legends|rope]], a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bannon first appeared as a character in the adventure module "[[Conical Six Summit]]," one of several modules included in the ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'' sourcebook for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system. The book, which was released in [[2014]], gave several reasons why the players might be climbing the mountain when they find Bannon, although hunting vynocks is the reason used throughout the adventure text and so this article assumes this to be the case.
